title: Coconut Chicken Curry
description: Rich, warming, and deeply comforting curry cooked with fresh coconut milk and aromatic spices. This comes together in under an hour.

blocks.alt: A steaming bowl of chicken curry garnished with cilantro

blocks.text: This coconut chicken curry is the ultimate comfort food for a cold evening. It has a rich, velvety gravy made with full-fat coconut milk and warm, toasted spices.

items.text: Heat oil in a large pot. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add pureed tomatoes and cook until oil starts separating from the sides. Mix in turmeric, chili, and coriander powders.
Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, cover, and let simmer gently for 20 minutes until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and fresh cilantro before serving hot with rice.

blocks.text: You can add chopped potatoes or red bell peppers for extra texture and color.
